_Do you enjoy understanding how machines and technical systems work - and turning that knowledge into practical solutions? Are you motivated by working with complex engineering challenges and interested in the equipment and systems behind modern beverage production?

_We are looking for a Filling and Packaging Engineer to join our Process & Packaging team in Allerød. Here, you will work with the design and engineering of technical systems, machinery and packaging solutions for the beverage industry.

You will contribute to projects from initial feasibility, design to tendering, equipment selection, FAT, commissioning and implementation. You may already have experience with packaging, filling or logistics systems, or you may come from a mechanical, mechatronics or similar engineering background with a strong interest in machinery and technical systems.

**Why join NIRAS?

**At NIRAS, you get the opportunity to work on complex engineering projects where technical expertise meets real-world production. You will work closely with clients, equipment suppliers and colleagues across different engineering disciplines to develop solutions that work in practice.

You will become part of an international environment, collaborating with colleagues and specialists across NIRAS and our sister companies in the Netherlands, UK and Ireland.

The role gives you the opportunity to follow projects through different phases and develop a broad understanding of the entire project lifecycle - while building specialist knowledge within packaging and filling systems.

With around 10–20% travel, you will also have the opportunity to experience projects and production facilities on site and work directly with clients and technical teams.

**Welcome to Process & Packaging

**You will join our Process & Packaging team in Allerød, where we work across disciplines and departments to deliver engineering solutions for clients within the beverage industry.

We work with both small and large clients and support projects involving the technical systems, equipment and facilities behind beverage production. Our work spans from early-stage design and engineering to procurement, installation and commissioning.

You will work alongside experienced colleagues and specialists and become part of a team where knowledge sharing, collaboration and technical curiosity are highly valued.

**Your new workday will include

**As a Filling and Packaging Engineer, you will work with the engineering of machinery, technical systems and packaging and filling solutions. Your tasks may include:

• Design and engineering of technical systems and machinery for packaging and filling facilities including supporting process installations and logistics systems

• Developing technical solutions and layouts for packaging and filling equipment

• Preparing design and tender documentation and supporting supplier evaluations

• Participating in CAPEX projects, including equipment selection, FAT, commissioning and implementation

• Solving technical challenges and optimising solutions directly at packaging and filling facilities

• Working with CAD and other engineering/design tools

• Collaborating with equipment suppliers, clients and multidisciplinary engineering teams

• Following projects through different phases, from concept and design to implementation

• Supporting the development of technical documentation and project material

**What We Are Looking For

**We imagine that you have an engineering background and are curious about how technical systems and machinery work. You may already have experience from the beverage, food or packaging industry, but this is not necessarily a requirement.

We are looking for someone who:

• Holds a degree in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, process engineering or another relevant technical field

• Have some experience working with technical systems, engineering or production equipment

• Has an interest in or experience with packaging, filling systems, machinery or production facilities

• Has experience with design and engineering of technical systems

• Is familiar with CAD and drawing tools, preferably also PDM/PLM systems

• Has experience with technical documentation and databases

• Has knowledge of or experience with CAPEX projects, FAT, commissioning or implementation of equipment

• Has good English skills, both written and spoken

• Communicates clearly and enjoys collaborating in a multidisciplinary environment

• Is a team player who enjoys working together with colleagues, clients and suppliers

• Is technically curious, solution-oriented and motivated by learning how things work

Most importantly, you are curious about engineering, machinery and production systems and motivated to develop your expertise within packaging and filling technology.

**Here we grow

**Do you want to be part of a workplace where you grow both personally and professionally? A workplace where your skills are allowed to develop in a strong professional community and where your personal preferences and future dreams are always taken seriously?

At NIRAS, we work to grow into a more sustainable future based on good preparation. That is why we make sure that our employees grow with us. We do this through collaboration, knowledge sharing and creative solutions - do you want to grow with us? Then don’t hesitate to apply through this page, we look forward to hearing from you!

Join us in this role where you’ll ensure accurate and stable daily calculations for our gas portfolio. You’ll analyse and explain market-to-market values and risk metrics, helping colleagues understand portfolio performance and make well-informed commercial decisions.

Welcome to Structuring & Analysis

You’ll be part of Structuring & Analysis where you, together with your colleagues, will provide quantitative analysis and reliable calculations for the gas portfolio. You’ll work close to the trading business, and risk management colleagues, connecting technical results with daily commercial decisions.

As a team, we share knowledge, support each other, and take pride in delivering clear, dependable insights in a fast-moving environment.

You’ll play an important role in:

• ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and operational stability of end-of-day calculations for the gas portfolio

• analysing and explaining the market-to-market value of the portfolio and the factors driving changes

• connecting portfolio results with risk metrics and explaining the calculations used in risk reporting

• supporting the gas portfolio with day-to-day quantitative analysis and timely investigation of results

• acting as a point of contact between the gas portfolio and development colleagues to improve tools and calculations

• identifying opportunities to strengthen calculation processes, controls, and analytical quality.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have a master’s degree in mathematics, statistics, physics, engineering, finance, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience

• apply mathematical and statistical knowledge to practical business questions and can investigate results with accuracy and attention to detail

• have programming experience and can work confidently with financial domain specific languages, quantitative models, and calculation tools

• communicate complex technical concepts clearly and patiently to both technical and non-technical colleagues

• work well with stakeholders in a fast-moving environment, respond constructively when priorities change, and take ownership of issues

• have knowledge of European gas markets or experience in a desk quant, trading, portfolio, or risk environment, or are motivated to develop this knowledge.

Imagine a future where you'll protect the ability to supply electricity and heat to the end user and make sure that our critical OT systems are protected against hackers

We offer a workplace culture where you’ll be working from the office every work day.

Join us in this role where you’ll be working as a Senior Operational Technology (OT) Security Officer to strengthen the security, resilience, and compliance of Ørsted Bioenergy. In this role, you will act as a trusted security lead across OT, IT, engineering, and operations, helping protect critical systems while enabling safe, reliable, and efficient operations. Further more we are partnering with operations, engineering, maintenance, IT, and third-party vendors to ensure security controls are practical, risk-based, and compatible with operational safety and availability – and we “translate” technical cyber risk into clear business, safety, and operational impact requirements. We operate in complex, multi-site, international, or safety-critical operational environments.

**Welcome to Bioenergy

**You’ll be part of OT Security where you, together with your colleagues, will be working on Ørsted Danish powerplant. Our task is to protect the powerplants ability to produce electricity and heat against hacker attacks. So you need to understand Danish, when you’re out on the powerplants. We are a small team of 4 persons located in Jutland (Jylland) who works together and strive in helping each other in our daily tasks. As a team, we have an open and direct commutation where we discuss ideas strategy and ideas to develop and mature our solutions, so they are robust and they deal with the reality we face.

You’ll play an important role in:

• leading the development and continuous improvement of OT security governance, policies, standards, and procedures

• assessing, managing, and reducing cyber risk across OT environments, including industrial control systems, SCADA, PLCs, IIoT, and related networks

• defining and supporting secure OT architecture, including network segmentation, secure remote access, asset visibility, access control, logging, monitoring, and vulnerability management

• conducting OT security risk assessments, gap analyses, and maturity reviews aligned with recognised frameworks e.g. Danish legislation “Lov om styrket Beredskab i Energisektoren”, IEC 62443, ISO 27001 and relevant regulatory requirements

• partnering with operations, engineering, maintenance, IT, and third-party vendors to ensure security controls are practical, risk-based, and compatible with operational safety and availability requirements

• driving OT security awareness and training for technical and operational teams.

To succeed in the role, you:

• hold a relevant degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, Automation, or equivalent practical experience

• understand and know how to operate in ICS systems and possess understanding of 24/7 production environment

• are familiar with IT networks like, Purdue model, firewall, data diodes etc.

• hold knowledge about EIC 62433, ISO 27001 and "Lov om styrket Beredskab i Energisektoren" as we operate according to this legislation

• are a good team player and at the same are strong on being responsible of incl. conducting your own tasks – you need to be fluent in both Danish and English language as well due to nature our stake holder landscape

• are flexible - both in terms of taking on tasks outside your comfortzone, being curious in learning new areas and assist your team in whatever tasks are needed.

Some travel within Denmark to the different sites must be expected in the this role.

jobs.occupation: Senior researcher combined with a professorship in molecular mechanisms of diabetes
jobs.description:
A position as senior researcher (“group leader”) at the Bartholin Institute, Department of Pathology, Centre for Diagnostics, Rigshospitalet, Copenhagen University Hospital is open for appointment from as soon as possible.

The position is combined with a position as professor or associate professor with special focus on translational type 1 or 2 diabetes research at the Biotech Research and Innovation Centre, Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen.

With this position the Bartholin Institute wishes to strengthen the leadership in translational type 1 or 2 diabetes research in collaboration with the University of Copenhagen.

It is a requirement that the applicant is accepted for appointment of both the professorship/the associate professorship and the senior researcher position.

The advertisement for the professorship/the associate professorship is available from the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen Professor or Associate Professor and Research Group Leader with special focus on molecular mechanisms of diabetes

About the department

The Bartholin Institute is an experimental cancer and diabetes research department at Rigshospitalet, Department of Pathology, Centre for Diagnostics. The Bartholin Institute is also affiliated with the University of Copenhagen as part of the Biotech Research and Innovation Centre (BRIC). The Bartholin Institute houses three research groups and is situated at Copenhagen Biocenter close to Rigshospitalet and academic institutions.

Research functions and focus areas of the department

The Bartholin Institute is a research department working on various aspects of cancer biology and diabetes. The department covers aspects on cancer growth, recurrence, microenvironment and pathogenesis of diabetes.

Qualifications

For all applicants, regardless of academic background, documentation for competences in the field of laboratory based translational diabetes research should be specified. The capacity of the candidate to integrate research and clinical perspectives is emphasized**. The successful candidate is expected to strengthen and expand the departments research into translational diabetes research. Hence, it is essential that the applicant has a proven track-record within this area. The applicant is expected to establish a cutting-edge research program with clear translational potential and should also have demonstrated the ability to attract external funding to sustain such a program.

Conditions

In order to be considered, the applicant must send an application to both the Faculty (the professorship or the associate professorship) and to the hospital (the senior researcher position) cf. the simultaneously advertised position of the professorship/associate professorship. Appointment is conditioned by the fact that the applicant obtains both positions. This also applies to the applicants who are already employed at Copenhagen University Hospital - Rigshospitalet.

Salary and conditions are as agreed between the Danish Regions and the relevant trade union and between the Capital Region/Region Zealand and University of Copenhagen.

As professor at least 50 % of the working time will be allocated to academic tasks (e.g., research, teaching, evaluation tasks and communication with the public) in agreement with the Director at the

Biotech Research and Innovation Centre (BRIC). The remaining time will be allocated for other tasks at the Bartholin Institute and the Department of Pathology (e.g. research administration, personnel responsibility, methods establishment and development, grant writing and the establishment of a competitive research group) in agreement with the Head of the Bartholin Institute. The professor will receive a start package covering the salary of 1-2 group members and technical support equivalent to 50 % of a full-time technical position from the Bartholin Institute. Additional support and details on the working conditions must be negotiated with the Head of the Bartholin Institute, Rigshospitalet.

Application procedure

The application must include the following:

• Curriculum Vitae and a complete list of publications

• A research plan, describing how the applicant sees him/herself contributing to the Bartholin Institute

• A description of how the applicant is qualified as for the position including experience as communicator, collaborator, manager/administrator/organizer, and Scholar/researcher/teacher.

The application deadline is 19 November 2026.

Further information

For further information please contact Head of Department, Bjarne Winther Kristensen tel. + 45 2396 3602, or email: bjarne.winther.kristensen.01@regionh.dk.

Salary and terms of employment will be in accordance with the applicable collective agreement between Danish Regions and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Looking for a career in PMO and project management?

We are looking for a structured and proactive PMO Project Manager to join our Unified Platform (UP) Program. In this role, you will become a key part of the Program Management Office (PMO) and support the successful delivery of a global business transformation and rollout program.

You will work across multiple initiatives and stakeholders, helping to ensure readiness, alignment, governance, reporting, and execution throughout the entire implementation lifecycle.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys combining project management, planning, stakeholder coordination, governance, and process improvement in an international environment.

Key Responsibilities

Program Tools & Digital Collaboration

You will be responsible for maintaining and continuously improving key program collaboration and management tools.

Responsibilities include:

• Owning and maintaining core UP collaboration platforms, including Jira, and Confluence.

• Acting as Jira administrator and supporting configuration, workflows, dashboards, reporting, and new project rollouts.

• Driving adoption of program tools and ensuring they support efficient collaboration and transparency across teams.

Pre-Implementation & Country Mobilization

You will play a central role in preparing countries for successful implementation and supporting rollout planning activities.

Responsibilities include:

• Coordinating country readiness activities, including Country Readiness Assessments (CRA), data preparation, master data validation, and implementation handovers.

• Supporting regional and global rollout sequencing and implementation planning.

• Facilitating alignment meetings with regional stakeholders and implementation teams.

• Driving readiness validation processes and ensuring prerequisites, dependencies, and readiness criteria are met before implementation.

Governance, Reporting & Delivery Support

You will work closely with System Owners to maintain visibility, alignment, and progress across initiatives and rollout projects.

Responsibilities include:

• Supporting status reporting, KPI tracking, progress monitoring, and executive reporting.

• Creating consolidated visibility across initiatives, projects, and system deliveries.

• Facilitating governance processes, coordinating decision-making forums, and tracking actions and dependencies.

• Supporting backlog management, prioritization activities, and cross-functional coordination.

• Driving communication, planning, training coordination, and change management activities where required.

• Providing operational and administrative support to ensure efficient day-to-day program execution.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a motivated and structured individual who is eager to build a career within project and program management.

You may be a recent graduate or have a few years of professional experience within project coordination, PMO, consulting, business transformation, logistics, supply chain, IT, or a related field.

We imagine that you:

• Hold a master's degree in Business, Economics, Supply Chain, Engineering, IT, Project Management, or a related discipline.

• Have 3 years of professional experience, though newly graduated candidates are also encouraged to apply.

• Are highly organized and enjoy creating structure, transparency, and follow-up in complex projects.

• Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Are proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of tasks and driving them to completion.

• Communicate clearly and professionally in English, both verbally and in writing.

• Thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working with stakeholders from different functions and countries.

• Are curious, eager to learn, and motivated by being part of a large-scale transformation program.

• Have experience with Microsoft Office tools and are interested in working with platforms such as Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, and Power BI.

Nice to Have

• Experience with ERP, TMS, Finance, Logistics, or Supply Chain transformations.

• Experience supporting global rollout programs.

What We Offer

• A key role in one of the company's most important transformation programs.

• Exposure to senior stakeholders and international teams.

• A broad role combining project management, governance, planning, reporting, and change management.

• Excellent opportunities for professional growth and development.

• A collaborative and ambitious working environment where you can make a real impact.

About us

Scan Global Logistics is a Nordic-based full-service global logistics provider present on all continents. From businesses across all industries to life-saving humanitarian organizations, we go above and beyond to bring anything anywhere – whether by road, rail, ocean or air.

We are guided by our fundamental virtues of Respect, Entrepreneurship, Integrity, and Fun and strive to bring a human approach to everyone, everywhere.

We run on the energy of good people, and no system or formula can compensate for that. Therefore, we also do what we can to unlock every employee's personal and professional potential so we can grow and thrive together.

Join Dynatest as a Software & Embedded Engineer and help us make every road a safer journey.

About Dynatest Since 1976, Dynatest has been shaping the future of smarter, safer, and more sustainable roads. We develop and manufacture world-leading pavement testing equipment, used by customers across the globe. Our equipment is in high demand, and we are therefore expanding our team with an experienced and multi-skilled Software & Embedded Engineer who can help us bring precision and reliability to every road project.

**Your work at Dynatest

**Based at our headquarter in Ballerup, you will join our growing software team, reporting to the Software Manager. You will work across the full stack—from embedded processors and PLCs, signal processing, communication protocols, and computer vision to higher-level software applications that interact with our machines. You will help define technical solutions and estimates for new hardware and software implementations, develop test procedures and specifications, and provide technical guidance to ensure robust, reliable, and maintainable solutions. The role also includes participation in customer-specific tasks to assess feasibility, identify optimal solutions, estimate costs and implementation effort, and report recommendations to the Software Manager.

As our Software & Embedded Engineer your assignments would be:

• Develop and maintain embedded firmware, PLC software, and supporting applications for pavement testing equipment and related systems

• Design and optimize software architectures, communication interfaces, and existing codebases to ensure performance, reliability, maintainability, and scalability

• Plan, execute, and document testing, validation activities, and software releases to ensure solutions meet technical and quality requirements

• Maintain clear and structured technical documentation covering software design, system changes, engineering decisions, and test results

• Support customer projects through technical clarification, feasibility assessments, solution development, and technical recommendations

• Collaborate across functions while contributing to engineering standards, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives

Professional qualifications

• Engineering degree in Automation, Electrical, Software, Mechatronics, or similar

• 3+ years of professional experience in software and embedded development

• Experience with several of the following: C, C++, C#, Structured Text (IEC 61131-3), VBA, communication protocols (e.g., TCP/IP, CAN, Modbus), signal processing, computer vision, Git and Jira (or similar)

• Solid problem-solving skills and an analytical, structured approach

• Experience with embedded processors and PLCs; familiarity with industrial sensors/actuators is an advantage

• Proficient in English

**Personal qualifications

**You are independent, self-driven, and take professional pride in your work. You work in a structured and systematic manner, continuously seek improvements, and are able to analyze and assess technical challenges. You understand consequences and dependencies across systems and thrive in collaboration with colleagues and stakeholders.

**Why you should join Dynatest

**We offer an exciting opportunity to work independently in a dynamic and informal environment. At Dynatest, you will be challenged both professionally and personally, with the chance to shape the company’s future and have a real impact on our products and solutions.

You will join a highly skilled team of professionals with deep technical expertise, contributing to maintaining and strengthening Dynatest’s position as the world’s leading provider of pavement testing equipment.

An exciting and independent position in an innovative engineering company with a high technical and professional level.

Dynatest is a growing company, offering excellent opportunities for both professional and personal development. Currently, we employ around 50 people in Ballerup, Denmark, and Florida, USA.

We offer attractive employee benefits, salary according to qualifications, wide-ranging responsibilities, and freedom with accountability.

_

Dynatest value diversity and inclusion. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of country of origin, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or age._

**About Us

**You know that rental bike you unlocked with your phone this morning? Or the tracker on your dog's collar that tells you he's two streets away, again? Neither of those works without a network connection. Onomondo is the layer that makes sure the data actually gets through.

We're the infrastructure behind the Internet of Things (IoT). Companies building connected products come to us for the connectivity that keeps their devices online, anywhere in the world, and for the platform where they manage, monitor, and troubleshoot it themselves.

****Where we sit

****We're somewhere between SaaS and telecom. We sell software, so we move fast, ship often, and care about the user experience. But we also operate inside telecommunications: which is more complex and technical than most software. Our customers are engineers, they ask hard questions and the relationship starts rather than ends at purchase.

That mix also makes us sticky. Most SaaS tools are nice to have. If our connectivity stops, our customers' products stop. That means our business grows as our customers and the industry grows. We've been growing fast and we don't plan to slow down, which is exactly why we need this role.

****Why this role exists

****At Onomondo, connectivity isn’t a commodity. It’s infrastructure. And our Account Managers are the ones who ensure our most important customers treat it that way.

We’re looking for a strategic Account Manager to own the post-signature commercial lifecycle of Onomondo’s largest and most complex accounts. This role sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, relationship ownership, and value delivery — with clear accountability for Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), renewal management, and account expansion including Net New MRR.

You’ll be expected to drive growth within existing accounts by proving value, navigating stakeholders, and designing expansion paths that turn early success into long-term reliance on Onomondo’s full-stack connectivity platform.

****What You’ll Be Doing

• Own the commercial relationship for a portfolio of Onomondo's largest, most complex accounts, as the main contact for decision-makers and budget holders. CS stays the technical and operational contact.

• Run renewals and negotiations, including contracts, pricing adjustments and commitment pacing, so revenue stays predictable and GRR is protected.

• Spot churn risk early and act on it, working with Finance, Legal and RevOps on SLAs, contract updates and billing.

• Find and build expansion: map stakeholders, uncover new business units, geographies and use cases, and turn them into pipeline and Net New MRR. Mutual Success Plans covering 12 to 24 months are part of this.

• Prove value every quarter through Impact Reviews that use data, benchmarks and real results to tie Onomondo to customer outcomes.

• Coordinate across teams and keep the data clean: align with CS, AEs, Product and RevOps, own commercial escalations, keep forecasts and renewal stages accurate, and keep the Ideal Expansion Profile up to date.

****What we're looking for

• Proven experience of 3 years+ managing strategic accounts in a B2B SaaS, telco, or connectivity context

• Demonstrated success owning a book of business with revenue responsibility (GRR, NRR)

• Ability to navigate complex stakeholder ecosystems and build C-level trust

• Strong commercial acumen — negotiation, forecasting, pricing, value-based selling

• Experience running QBRs, success planning, or account mapping at scale

• Knowledge of HubSpot, Tableau, or enterprise CRM/reporting tools

• Comfortable working cross-functionally with CS, Product, and Operations

• Structured thinker with excellent communication and executive presence

****Nice to Have

• Background in IoT, telecom, or infrastructure-as-a-service

• Familiarity with frameworks like SPICED or similar customer lifecycle models

• Experience managing multi-country deployments or hardware/software integrated customers

• Exposure to customers in sectors like logistics, manufacturing, or mobility

****Why join Onomondo?

****We’re not building another SIM provider. We’re building the infrastructure layer for the next generation of connected products. If you want to work in a scale-up that feels more like a challenger brand than a telecom — and you believe in clarity, accountability, and momentum — you’ll fit right in.

We're a team of engineers, operators, and commercial minds in Copenhagen who debate passionately about technical or GTM approaches and then go for a run together. Or padel. Or a beer. Or a boardgame night. People here stay curious, speak up when something feels off, and bring energy whether it's a product launch sprint or a Friday bar.

Practically speaking, that looks like: full health insurance, catered cooked-on-site lunch every day, an in-office gym with HIIT and yoga three times a week during work hours (we're serious about this), quarterly Friday bars, an espresso machine, a full snack and drink-bar and a pretty impressive breakfast setup.

****Our hiring process

****We care deeply about creating a fair and inclusive process.

That means:

• We don’t need your picture or cover letter - just your CV

• We select candidates based on skills and relevant work experience for the role.

****What you can expect:

• 30-minutes screening call with Giacomo, Sales & AM Director

• 90-minutes skill interview including business case (in-person) with Jillian (CCO), Giacomo & Cláudia(AM) - this is also an opportunity to meet some of your potential colleagues

• 30-minutes final stage - Meet one of our Co-founders Michael Karlsen

If you have questions, feel free to reach out to Giacomo, Sales & Account Management Director at +4521895512 .

****Ready to Make an Impact?

****Send us your application, and let’s start the conversation.

Note - We review and interview candidates continually, and therefore encourage you to apply at your earliest convenience.

**About GoWish, Ønskeskyen ☁️

**At GoWish, we’re building the world’s leading wish-list and social shopping platform - a place where you can make a real impact and have fun doing it.

We’re on a mission to reinvent gifting for millions. We win together, driven by curiosity, ownership, and bold ideas that turn into real products. We experiment cross-functionally, push for excellence, and keep things playful as we grow - together.

**Team & Role Overview

**We are looking for a systems-minded Senior ML Data Engineer to own the offline-to-online feature infrastructure that powers our real-time recommendation and search engines at scale. You will be building the low-latency data syncs and feature-serving layers that bridge our analytical warehouses with operational databases, caches, and Feature Stores. This is a role for a performance-driven engineer who excels at pipeline orchestration (Airflow, dbt), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Docker), and database tuning, ensuring our recommendation systems receive reliable data under strict low-latency SLAs. If you thrive on solving complex data synchronization challenges, scaling operational storage for millions of users, and acting as the operational bridge between Data Science and Backend Engineering - you will play a critical role in powering our product's core ML capabilities.

**What You'll Do

**

• Offline-to-Online Feature Pipelines: Build and operate resilient feature pipelines syncing transformed data from analytical warehouses (e.g., BigQuery) into operational storage layers (e.g., AlloyDB, Redis, Feature Stores) to serve real-time ML recommendation models at scale.

• Pipeline Orchestration and Transformations: Design, test, and maintain robust Apache Airflow DAGs and modular dbt transformations to automate end-to-end data ingestion and feature generation under strict low-latency SLAs.

• Infrastructure as Code and Reliability: Provision, scale, and automate cloud data infrastructure using Terraform, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines, implementing automated data quality testing and monitoring across all feature syncs.

• Cross-Functional System Design: Partner directly with Data Scientists and Backend Engineers to define online/offline feature contracts, optimize database schemas for sub-second queries, and eliminate training-serving skew for millions of active users.

**

• Operational Data Pipelines: Proven experience moving batch features from analytical warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake) into low-latency online stores (AlloyDB, Redis, Feature Stores) to serve real-time ML recommendation models.

Are you a well-organized, scientifically minded professional who enjoys working across science, operations, and business? Do you enjoy turning plans into action and ensuring that strategic priorities become measurable results?

At Gubra, we are looking for an Executive Business Partner to serve as a trusted partner to our Chief Scientific Officer (CSO) and Research Leadership Team. This is a high-impact role for a scientifically grounded and execution-oriented professional who combines strong business acumen with a hands-on mindset and a proven ability to translate strategic priorities into coordinated action and measurable results. You excel at bringing structure, driving accountability, and enabling organizational performance.

As Executive Business Partner, you will play a central role in supporting the CSO and Research Leadership Team in driving key priorities and ensuring effective execution across the Research organization. Your responsibilities will span leadership processes, OKRs, business planning and budgeting, Board and management materials, communication, and performance follow-up. You will also take ownership of selected cross-functional initiatives and special projects, stepping in where structure, analysis, coordination, or hands-on execution is needed.

The role offers a unique opportunity to work closely with the CSO and Research Leadership Team, collaborate with key stakeholders across Gubra, and make a tangible impact on how we operate, execute, and deliver on our priorities.

Key Responsibilities

• Serve as a trusted business partner to the CSO and Discovery Leadership Team by providing structured analysis, practical recommendations, and hands-on execution support to enable informed decision-making and successful execution.

• Partner closely with the CSO to drive key priorities and ensure alignment across the Discovery Leadership Team.

• Monitor execution of strategic initiatives and roadmaps, track KPIs and key milestones, proactively identify risks, and drive follow-up to ensure delivery.

• Plan, facilitate, and follow up on Discovery Leadership Team meetings, including agenda planning, decision tracking, and ensuring agreed actions are completed.

• Ensure leadership decisions are translated into clear actions, owners, timelines, and communication points.

• Own the OKR process in the CSO organization, including planning cycles, progress tracking, reporting, and follow-up to support organizational focus and accountability.

• Coordinate annual planning, budgeting, forecasting, and resource planning processes for the Research organization in collaboration with Finance and department leaders.

• Lead and coordinate cross-functional initiatives and special projects, taking hands-on ownership from scoping and analysis through implementation and delivery, while ensuring effective stakeholder management.

• Prepare Board, Executive Leadership Team, and management presentations by translating complex scientific, operational, and business information into clear decision-making materials.

• Develop executive communications, organizational updates, and leadership presentations that support alignment, transparency, and engagement across the Scientific organization.

• Identify opportunities to improve business processes and operational excellence, taking ownership of practical solutions that enhance efficiency and organizational effectiveness.

Required Experience

We imagine that you bring a strong scientific foundation combined with business acumen, strategic perspective, structured execution, and excellent stakeholder management. Your experience may come from consulting, biotech, pharma, project management, business operations, business partnering, or a similar role where you have worked across scientific, strategic, and operational priorities.

• PhD, in life sciences, pharmacology, or related disciplines or equivalent scientific experience

• 3+ years of relevant experience in consulting, biotech, pharma or related industries.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand the bigger picture, structure complex topics, and translate them into clear recommendations and actionable plans.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex scientific and business information into clear, concise, and impactful materials.

• Strong project management and execution skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple priorities, drive follow-through, and create momentum.

• High proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel, with experience in reporting, performance tracking, and preparing high-quality management materials.

• Ability to take initiative, work independently, collaborate effectively, exercise sound judgment, and handle confidential information responsibly.

• Experience working with senior leaders and across functions in a fast-paced environment.

To succeed in this role

You are a scientifically grounded professional who combines strategic perspective with a hands-on, execution-oriented mindset. You see the bigger picture while being equally comfortable diving into the details needed to move things forward. You thrive on translating strategic priorities into action and creating structure, clarity, accountability, and progress.

You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, taking ownership of complex and varied assignments, and moving between high-level discussions and hands-on execution. You build trusted relationships, influence without formal authority, and know when to challenge, support, and follow through.

Most importantly, you are someone who gets things done. You combine curiosity, sound judgment, and business understanding with a pragmatic approach and are motivated by helping the CSO and Research Leadership Team turn priorities and decisions into tangible outcomes.

Contact and application

Please apply at our website using the ”Apply” button. The deadline is October 27, 2026.

If you have questions regarding practical matters, you are welcome to contact HR Partner, Simone Sparholt at ssp@gubra.dk. Questions regarding role-specific details will be addressed during the interview.

We are looking forward to receiving your application.

About Gubra

Gubra is a disease-agnostic techbio company specialized in peptide-based drug discovery and development as well as preclinical contract research services striving for excellence at all levels. We insist on doing things efficiently – and often differently - to reach the results we aim for. Our vision is to become leaders in the path towards a more sustainable and healthier world. We do that by facilitating the discovery of new medicine, and by acting and inspiring others to fight the ongoing climate and biodiversity crises.

Gubra’s activities are focused on the early stages of drug development and are organised in two main highly synergistic business areas: Biotech and CRO Services. We generate our revenue by performing research for life science companies as well as by partnering projects from our discovery and development pipeline.

Our therapeutic focus is within metabolic and fibrotic diseases, and we specialize in in vivo pharmacology, ex vivo assays, drug profiling, histology, stereology and whole brain and organ imaging. In addition, we offer a full palette of advanced transcriptomics. Our ML/AI-driven peptide drug discovery platform streaMLine enables us to rapidly develop a peptide hit into a non-clinical candidate ready for development. Through a constant focus on high quality, scientific excellence, speed, and solid teamwork we have established ourselves as a highly professional and competent partner in the market.

People are our greatest asset, and our team consists of around 300 employees of which many are located in Hørsholm, Denmark. The mix of people from different cultures and educational backgrounds combined with our entrepreneurial mindset have greatly impacted our working environment, which is characterized by entrepreneurial drive, scientific curiosity, and teamwork – we join forces!

How do you turn a growing renewable energy portfolio into revenue? That question will be yours to answer as our new Senior Manager, Markets & Offtake in BeGreen's Commercial Team.

You will own the revenue side of BeGreen's portfolio – defining how our assets generate value, whether through merchant market exposure, contractual offtake arrangements, or direct behind-the-meter supply. Just as importantly, you will build the relationships and commercial agreements needed to bring that strategy to life.

Our projects are fully equity-financed by Equinor, allowing us to take merchant risk without requiring a Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) to secure financing. As a result, your market view is not simply a formality for lenders. It forms a fundamental basis for investment decisions.

Key Responsibilities

• Define and own BeGreen's market outlook, including power prices, capture rates (the share of wholesale market prices our assets actually realise), negative price hours, and the value of ancillary services across DK1, DK2 and the Swedish bidding zones SE3 and SE4.

• Approve the pricing and revenue assumptions used in investment cases before they are submitted for decision-making.

• Own the realised revenues of operating assets, currently including Ingerslev Å and additional projects coming online over the coming years. This includes realised power prices, balancing costs, curtailment, and ancillary services revenues. You will also hold our optimisation and balancing partners accountable for delivering on their commitments.

• Develop and negotiate offtake agreements, primarily balancing responsibility (BRP) and route-to-market/optimisation agreements on commercial terms, and PPAs where appropriate. Part of this activity is handled by Danske Commodities, Equinor's Danish energy trading business, requiring you to manage both internal collaboration and arm's length commercial relationships.

• Build and manage a pipeline of behind-the-meter opportunities with data centres, district heating companies, industrial customers, and similar counterparties, taking opportunities from initial engagement through to signed agreements.

• Own the commercial case for our Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects, including optimisation of revenue stacking across ancillary services, day-ahead and intraday markets.

• Monitor market design developments and regulatory changes affecting revenues, including tariffs, ancillary services markets, and grid connection frameworks, and translate these developments into commercial implications for our investment cases.

You will work across both solar and battery storage assets, including operating facilities and projects approaching final investment decision and construction. Activities are primarily located in Denmark, with an expanding portfolio in Sweden.

Project sizes typically range from 20 MW to 400 MW, with investment volumes between €50 million and €350 million.

Who We Are Looking For

You have a minimum of five years of experience within the Nordic or European electricity markets and a strong understanding of power price formation, ancillary services markets, and common offtake structures.

You have managed commercial agreements from initial discussions through to signed contracts, whether in offtake, PPAs, route-to-market arrangements, or similar commercial structures.

You are highly analytical and comfortable working with financial and commercial models. You will have analytical support available for model development, but you will own the key questions, the quality of the answers, and the commercial decisions that follow.

This role requires both attention to detail and strategic perspective. You must be able to challenge a revenue model and then defend your conclusions before an investment committee. The next day, you may be negotiating commercial terms with a data centre developer or a district heating company.

You thrive in environments where not everything has already been defined and where there is no ready-made playbook. You are credible with senior external counterparties and effective in collaborating across internal functions. You can communicate complex commercial positions in a clear and accessible manner.

You are fluent in both Danish and English, written and spoken.

Experience with battery storage revenue streams, ancillary services markets, behind-the-meter solutions, or co-location opportunities is considered an advantage. We are open regarding your background and welcome candidates from energy trading, aggregationaggregators, utilities, project developersment, advisory services, or related sectors.

About BeGreen

BeGreen is an integrated renewable power producer. We develop, build, own and operate onshore energy facilities across Denmark and Sweden, primarily with a focus on solar parks and battery storage systems. We retain long-term ownership of our assets, which means every project must create value over decades – technically, commercially and in the communities that host them.

BeGreen is wholly owned by the international energy company Equinor.

We are around 55 colleagues, headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Our values – collaboration, integrity and ambition – shape our projects, our decisions and the way we work together.

What we offer

• You will report directly to our Chief Commercial Officer and help shape a new role in the organization

• Exposure across the full project lifecycle - from early development through construction to operations

• A collaborative, international work environment with passionate and ambitious colleagues

• A strong focus on professional development and continuous learning

• Office based in Carlsberg Byen, Copenhagen.

If you have any questions, please contact

Mathias Vedsted Therkildsen

Chief Commercial Officer

Mail: mvt@begreen.dk

Company Description

With more than 3000 employees Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, and Consulting.

About the team

Join our Transfer Pricing team of more than 45 colleagues in Copenhagen and Aarhus. We help international and Danish businesses turn complex tax, finance and operating-model questions into practical solutions. You will build your expertise through real client work, structured learning and close collaboration and help clients navigate tax and transfer pricing challenges.

Job Description

You will work on a wide range of transfer pricing projects across various sectors. Together with your colleagues, you will help clients manage operational transfer pricing matters, audits and compliance, and provide both global and local advice. You can expect a steep learning curve, and  responsibilities that grow with your experience - supported by structured onboarding, regular feedback and close collaboration with experienced colleagues. Alongside your client work, you will have opportunities to attend training in Denmark and at Deloitte University in Paris, strengthening both your technical expertise and client-facing skills.

Ready to take the next step in your career? In this role, you will be involved in:

• Collect and analyse financial and business data for transfer pricing projects across sectors.

• Prepare transfer pricing documentation, benchmarking analyses and intercompany agreements.

• Support audits, international tax requirements and country-by-country reporting.

• Turn your analysis into clear client advice, join client meetings and follow up on agreed actions.

• Contribute ideas to proposals, AI-enabled tools and practical improvements to how we work.

We work in a dynamic, international environment with an informal tone, where quality, collaboration and different perspectives are central to how we create value for clients and for each other.

AI-enabled and digital tools are a natural part of how we work. You will learn to use them responsibly to explore data, support research and benchmarking, improve workflows and strengthen deliverables. No prior AI expertise is required - curiosity, sound judgement and a willingness to learn matter most.

We value the community that extends beyond client work. Our employee association brings people together throughout the year - from social events to shared experiences that cut across teams and business units. We celebrate the wins, big and small, and make a point of recognising individual and shared milestones

The role is full-time, and we are looking for professionals for our offices in both Copenhagen and Aarhus, Denmark.

Qualifications

We are looking for Consultants and Senior Consultants with 0–3 years of relevant experience.

We imagine that you are curious, ambitious and motivated by complex challenges. You take ownership of your responsibilities, collaborate openly with colleagues and clients, and contribute to bringing projects to a successful conclusion.

What you bring to the team:

• A relevant academic background, such as law, economics, finance, accounting or business.

• 0–3 years of relevant experience; internships and student roles are also valuable.

• Analytical, conceptual-thinking and problem-solving skills.

• Curiosity about technology and judgement when using AI-enabled tools.

• Clear communication and an interest in turning complexity into practical advice.

• Good energy and a strong client service instinct

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

Additional Information

Do you want to be part of our team?

Click the "I am interested" button above if you are ready to join our team.

Send your CV, grade transcript and application in which you present yourself and elaborate on your motivation for pursuing a career in Transfer Pricing and/or highlight relevant projects or previous experience by 5 November 2026. We regularly call for interviews, so send your application already today.

Please do not hesitate to contact Partner Cecilie Emilie Rendtorff at +45 26 61 53 93 or Aske Haahr Lauridsen at +45 20 41 35 92 if you have any questions about the position.

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide a consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

Are you an experienced craftsman with a passion for traditional craftsmanship and decorative work?

We are a Danish construction company specialising in high-end properties, historic and listed buildings, and projects that require a high level of craftsmanship and attention to detail.

We are looking for an experienced façade decorator, stucco worker or specialist mason with proven experience in decorative façade work and traditional building techniques.

The ideal candidate will have several years of experience working with cornices, mouldings, ornaments, decorative façades, stucco and detailed plasterwork, and will know how to recreate and restore decorative features with the precision and quality required when working on historic and architecturally significant buildings.

We are not necessarily looking for a traditional bricklayer. What is most important to us is that you are highly skilled in your craft and have genuine experience with decorative and ornamental work carried out using traditional methods.

We are looking for someone who:

● Has solid and documented experience in façade decoration, stucco work or specialist masonry

● Has experience working on historic, older or listed buildings

● Is experienced in traditional techniques and materials

● Has a strong eye for detail, proportions and high-quality finishes

● Is able to work independently and take responsibility for the quality of their work

● Understands and respects the original architecture of historic buildings

● Can provide professional references and preferably photographs of previous projects

What we offer

You will become part of a professional team working on exclusive and unique properties and projects where traditional craftsmanship and attention to detail are highly valued.

jobs.occupation: PhD position at the Center for Polariton-driven Light-Matter Interactions (POLIMA)
jobs.description:
The Center for Polariton-driven Light-Matter Interactions (POLIMA) at The Mads Clausen Institute, University of Southern Denmark, is seeking a talented and highly motivated PhD student to work on the development of new theoretical frameworks for describing light–matter interactions in advanced van der Walls heterostructures probed by polaritons generated through inelastic tunneling. The position is funded by a Villum Young Investigator grant awarded to Assistant Professor P. André D. Gonçalves, who will supervise the PhD research.

The position is available starting 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The successful candidate will develop new theoretical frameworks and computational methods to investigate the fundamental limits of polariton-mediated inelastic electron tunneling in tunnel junctions based on van der Waals heterostructures composed of atomically thin materials. The project will employ a broad range of analytical, semi-analytical, and numerical techniques to explore electrically driven polaritonic phenomena. A major focus will be on harnessing polariton-mediated inelastic electron tunneling as a tool to probe and manipulate light–matter interactions at the nanoscale, as well as to characterize the optoelectronic response of complex quantum materials.

We welcome candidates with a strong background in condensed-matter physics and/or quantum nanophotonics who are highly motivated and eager to pursue world-class research in theoretical quantum nano-optoelectronics. Experience with scientific programming is expected, while familiarity with numerical techniques is advantageous but not required. The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic about contributing to cutting-edge research in a dynamic and ambitious young research group, supported by the POLIMA Center and its extensive network of international collaborators.

POLIMA is a Center of Excellence funded by the Danish National Research Foundation (DNRF) for an initial period of 6 years (2023–2028), with the possibility of a 4-year extension. The center is led by Professor N. Asger Mortensen and currently consists of two Professors, three Assistant Professors, a Lab Manager, a Center Administrator, and approximately 10–15 PhD students, postdocs, and visiting scientists. Several POLIMA researchers have attracted prestigious personal grants, e.g., Villum Investigator, Villum Young Investigator, DFF Sapere Aude, Novo Nordisk’s Foundation RECRUIT and Data Science Investigator – Emerging, and Maria Skłodowska-Curie Fellowships. Read more on POLIMA’s website.

We offer a competitive and highly collaborative research environment with close interaction between experimental and theoretical activities. You will join a thriving community of researchers and benefit from a strong network of international collaborators. Our work environment is supportive, dynamic, and designed to foster creativity and the development of innovative projects.

 

We offer:

• A PhD student position in an ambitious and supportive, international research environment.

• A dedicated supervisor research team to support the academic development of the PhD student.

POLIMA is located at the University of Southern Denmark in Odense – 1h15min by train from Copenhagen Airport. The University of Southern Denmark offers dedicated assistance and support with various practical, social, and legal aspects (housing, visa, administration, tax, etc.), especially for international candidates through our international staff office (ISO) and the administrative staff at POLIMA.

 

For further information and details about the position, application, and the research center, please contact Assistant Professor Paulo André Dias Gonçalves (padgo@mci.sdu.dk).

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk.
